We need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups in the sample's molecule. We have carbon NMR shifts list. Carbonyl carbons typically appear around 160-220 ppm (for ketones ~200, esters ~170-180, amides ~165-180, acids ~170-185). In the list we have a shift at 160.80 ppm. Others are lower (135-124 aromatic, 57, 41, etc). So likely one carbonyl group.

But could be more than one carbonyl if overlapping? Only one shift in carbonyl region. So answer 1.

We could also check IR for C=O stretch ~1700 cm-1, but we didn't get IR. Could try again with correct parameters? The tool expects maybe no arguments. Let's call ir_spectra with empty object.
